description.value: The South Cowichan Branch of the Vancouver Island Regional Library has served the Mill Bay area since opening in 1989, with roots in the original Shawnigan Lake branch established in 1946. Located in a multi-unit commercial building, the branch offers meeting room bookings, public computing resources, home delivery for patrons unable to visit, and a full range of library services. It sits on the traditional territory of the Quw'utsun' (Cowichan) and Malahat peoples.

address.value: 2720 Mill Bay Road, Mill Bay, V8H 1H9
